Added migration structure assertions for event/Issue uniqueness and absence of customer/quiz columns
Added signed raw-body integration fixture that verifies HMAC, parses the minimized envelope and creates exactly one private Issue
Replaying the same signed event returns the existing permanent Issue instead of inserting another
Concurrent duplicate delivery produces one commercial Issue with processed+duplicate outcomes
Signed Fourthwall test notifications produce zero production Issues
Integrated the integration suite into normal pnpm test execution
